name: Bell Boeing V-22 Osprey
armament: Ramp-mounted 7.62 mm or 12.7 mm MG; optional belly turret
protection: Game: airframe immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm damage rotor, engines and cockpit glass (forced landing on accumulated hits); launchers and MANPADS (off-list) destroy it.
visual_notes: Tilt-rotor: high wing with two rotating nacelles and 3-blade proprotors
Twin vertical fins on a high tail, rear loading ramp
Nose refuelling probe; folding wing/rotor for ship stowage
JGSDF operates 17 MV-22B from Camp Saga supporting the Amphibious Rapid Deployment Brigade
